summary: Full-stack test of AHS Nesting Engine V0.1. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass (algorithms, generate, nest schema, no-overlap/spacing geometric verification using Shapely, within-media bounds, determinism, fixed-height, debug payload, benchmark). Frontend Playwright E2E verified: header renders, all data-testids present (btn-generate/nest/clear/reset/height-fixed, inputs for spacing/rotation-step/media-width, toggle-debug-mode with bbox/candidates/rejected/collisions overlays, tab-benchmark with 4 presets and run button). Generate->Nest flow renders 20 nested polygons, Result Metrics populate (Utilization 68.9%, Used Height 42.12cm, Proc Time 279.5ms). Clear empties canvas, Reset restores defaults (spacing 0.3). Fixed Height toggle reveals input-media-height. Benchmark runs 10/20/50 and populates results rows with time/height/util/fail/candidates columns.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py builds a new STRtree on every placement (O(n) rebuild each shape, O(n^2) total). For 100 shapes @ rotation_step 5 this contributes to the ~25s runtime E1 reported. Consider incremental insertion or batched rebuild for V0.2.
generate_candidates uses Python set + sort each iteration; fine for prototype but will dominate at count>=100. Fine for V0.1.
No HTTP error handling / Pydantic validation errors are passed through FastAPI defaults — fine for prototype.
server.py imports MongoDB client but no routes use it; dead code for V0.1 (can be removed to simplify).
seed_data_creation: /api/generate seed=1 count=20 used for deterministic tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend geometric correctness (no overlap, spacing >= 0.3cm) is verified via Shapely polygon distance checks in test_nest_no_overlap_and_spacing. Determinism verified by comparing full placement tuples across two /api/nest calls. Frontend tests used rotation_step=15 and 20 objects to stay within reasonable response times. Benchmark auto-selected presets 10/20/50 in the UI and completed in ~5s total.
